notes.title: Patch April
notes.notes:

+Fixed Entering back game during Inchester base shootout will not opening the end door.
+Fixed Blueprints can be grab outside secret containers

notes.title: Major Update Banzai Escape 2
notes.notes:
Good Day Everyone! 

Today we have a major update to Banzai Escape 2 including some new features:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/9c5f5dfc0f9a922eafd383a58f289d063131b811.png[/img]

[h1][b]STEAM WORKSHOP SUPPORT[/b][/h1]

Now modders can upload their creations to steam workshop directly. Players can subscribe and use it in the game.

Link to Banzai Escape 2 workshop page:
[url=steam://url/SteamWorkshopPage/1230990]steam://url/SteamWorkshopPage/1230990[/url]

In order to create mods, a new tool is provided within Banzai Escape 2 folder: BE2ModdingTool. 
This tool can assist modder to upload/update/install workshop mods.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/f7ead139d8a86452c51539cb528c9630a521a1e5.jpg[/img]

To install any mod, users need to subscribe the mod manually from steam workshop page. 
Clicking the subscribe button on any mod will download and install the mod. Installed mods will appear on mod tool list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/aec903dd56f898fee74b690570a82dab64ed4b49.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/b1be1dbace7204b94aa201ab3e4d89f90422f415.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/d711c53c027c889af236e32c56172112e6fb494e.png[/img]

We also provide documentation for mod tool inside Banzai Escape 2 installed folder.
Well to mod the content itself, you may need Unity 5.6.3p1 and use the ModModelPackage.unitypackage inside game’s mod folder

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/96817235565396fdf4b590ef7b03bce17c235b36.png[/img]

!IMPORTANT!
Any modder who already mod the model once need to update their mod again with new ModModelPackage.unitypackage. 
We did change how the game read new addon folder.

Tutorial will be given soon

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/e15c0df445bc518d22b2dab67024d336d0865c3e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/67ee1fa77a7d300b52ddbbe872acc8871f82c8a4.png[/img]

//=======================================================
Next, Official new localization: 

[h1][b]SIMPLIFIED CHINESE[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/9c92b6b02a7e778d12cfdff76a4b060e369c4667.png[/img]

Banzai Escape 2 now supports a new text language.
To use the Simplified Chinese language, head over to start game main menu, go to 'Option' and select 'Language'.
Simplified Chinese can be choose from drop-down menu on text language option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/7828e305d2c51315d0d5ee4a6149c4fe22f5571b.png[/img]

//=======================================================

Next, we also do some fixing many bugs we encounter in-game. Here's the changelog:
+ Fixed beaten Inchester on gantry level can be interact before all Lanun's are killed 
+ Fixed no boundary on Imingter defend area sewer tunnel player can go out of boundary 
+ Fixed no collider on the train wreck area (town map) 
+ Fixed Tunguska tank will always show "RESIST" upon hit, before mission destroy tanks. 
+ Fixed running toggle 
+ Fixed text upgrade capacity change "by 30" to "to 30" 
+ Fixed Merchant sell scroll items 
+ Fixed some text cannot be translated 
+ Fixed wrong merchant talk tips on level Inchester and lab 
+ Fixed upgrade status show right information after upgrade 
+ Fixed steel frame holes can be shot through on Pirate Base Lab Core area 
+ Fixed godmode cheat on Nuri vs SpecAlpha mission 
+ Add spotlight at Information center backdoor on town level 
+ Add waypoint on starting pirate base lab mission at the side door on Pod chamber 
+ Add hidden funder for Xenoaisam Studio at credits 
+ Disable automatic swap weapon on pickup. Swap only when there's only empty slot 
+ Change button text on Lanun warehouse switch to include inserting R&D key.

notes.title: Banzai Escape 2 Released!
notes.notes:
Good Day Everyone!

Today is a great day to celebrate!

Today is the day of Banzai Escape 2 released!
After taking about 4 years long development and developed with mostly about 2-3 peoples and now we managed to release it to the world!

Here's the game store page!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1230990/Banzai_Escape_2/

Thank you for all of you who are supporting us back then till now!
And We are sorry for lacking lots of news. The development took hell of our time in developing this game.
-But We consider this game as our grand masterpieces! We give lots of sweat on creating it!
Hope You Guys Will Enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/0752656a5ebf43d030496a992417636bc7cf7fed.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/e1c7d0bbb9fbcd81c595221503bb598bf8d21245.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/759bb105c390be17eba29d7d7d86e5f4dedae5e1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/39577a9f3f3d39516b2c01f50a5fb1f7cf688102.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/3f5dc155b98e5b5de000dc55417c34167ff0f6a1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/858f9e7b539afc95d6714d39357211c938796144.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/35794c1accfb82091a61c3ebd5ed5beaa394c31b.jpg[/img]

Yes! Nothing is perfect! Because our team is small, we are lacking man-powers and resource (money of course) to perfecting this game! So, expecting you will encounter some minor bugs. But we confident there’s no major bugs that make it unplayable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36738703/233ae7d52e46aad968234bac00ca7cfbb1280b3f.png[/img]

And there’s more!
We also in process of integrating this game to the STEAM WORKSHOP!
Mod is fully functional, and there’s a tool inside game directory to allow player to start mod-ing. Sadly, no tutorial or documentation yet! But feel free to asking us, especially me (XenoAisam) on chat group on how to mod-ing

Banzai Escape 2 Chat Group:
https://s.team/chat/YHfk9pky

No STEAM achievement? Don’t worry! We will integrate it in the future when the times comes! We hope you guy will play it and get the fun to the bottom of your heart! 

Thank you once again!
AND PLEASE SHARE ABOUT THIS GAME TO OTHERS!

Aisam :)
